change: Add a Close in or run off mode to the endless area workshop

mutations.name: the powers in the bottom are multiplied, not added
mutations.find: p(i){ let n=0, d=1; for(const [a,b] of this.R()[i].f){ n=n*b+a*d; d*=b; }
mutations.replace: p(i){ let n=1, d=1; for(const [a,b] of this.R()[i].f){ n=n*a; d*=b; }
